headlines: The S&P 500, a broad measure of big US companies, slipped about 0.2% on Wednesday.
A fresh inflation report showed prices still rising, which kept investors cautious.
Chip and AI-related stocks fell, with Nvidia down about 4%.
Investors shifted money from tech into more traditional companies, so the Dow rose about 0.3%.
